visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with two cats, a calico and a dark tabby, sitting on a soft grey cushion by a large window. In the background, a sprawling city skyline is visible under a hazy, blue-toned morning sky. The cats are nuzzling each other, with the dark tabby grooming the calico's face. White variety-show subtitles appear at the center. (2) The scene cuts to an indoor carpeted floor where an orange-and-white cat and the dark tabby are engaged in playful wrestling. The tabby is on its back, paws up, while the orange cat leans over it. They move dynamically, rolling and swatting gently. The lighting is bright and even, typical of an indoor living space. (3) A close-up shot introduces a 2026 desk calendar featuring a cat's face on the cover. A human hand enters the frame, holding a small square stamp with a cat illustration. The hand then stamps a "to-do list" box onto a paper surface and a pen is used to write text. Finally, an orange-and-white cat looks directly into the camera in a brightly lit studio setting with promotional text overlays and a website URL visible.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with lighthearted, whimsical BGM featuring a rhythmic piano and glockenspiel melody. There are no vocals, and the background remains quiet except for a soft ambient room tone. (2) A series of sharp cat growls and aggressive meowing sounds are introduced as the cats wrestle. The BGM remains constant in the background, creating a comedic contrast with the animal sound effects. (3) A clear transition sound effect, a sharp "pop," occurs. A male narrator begins speaking in a high-arousal, energetic, and professional tone, articulating Chinese words clearly to describe a product set. (4) The narrator continues with rapid speech, punctuated by the mechanical sound of a stamp hitting paper and the subtle rustle of stationary. (5) The video concludes with a friendly closing sentence from the narrator followed by a short, high-pitched cat meow SFX as the music fades out quickly.

It aims to generate sales by showcasing the product features and providing pre-order information.
